title: Unified Sharp Bounds on Probabilities of Causation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Probabilities of causation (PoCs) have developed steadily, from the binary measures first introduced by Pearl to the non-binary setting recently studied by Shu et al. As the theory has matured, PoCs have found applications in a growing range of areas, including personalized medicine, marketing and legal attribution. Shu et al. proposed closed-form bounds for multi-valued treatments and outcomes and proved them valid, but left their sharpness in high dimensions open. We close this gap with a mathematical proof. We further show that $\PNS$, $\PSub$, $\PRep$ and $\PN$ are all special cases of a single, more general formula. Combined with their equivalence classes, this settles the question of sharp bounds for discrete PoCs from experimental and observational data: in every dimension, they are given in closed form by a single theorem.

translated_title: 因果概率的统一紧致界
translated_abstract: 因果概率从 Pearl 最初提出的二元度量，逐步发展到 Shu 等人最近研究的非二元情形。随着理论的成熟，因果概率在个性化医疗、市场营销和法律归因等日益广泛的领域中得到了应用。Shu 等人针对多值处理和结果提出了闭式界并证明了其有效性，但在高维情形下这些界是否紧致仍未解决。我们通过数学证明填补了这一空白。我们进一步证明，PNS、PSub、PRep 和 PN 都是一个更一般的统一公式的特例。结合它们的等价类，这解决了基于实验和观测数据的离散因果概率紧致界问题：在任意维度下，这些界都由单个定理以闭式形式给出。
tldr: 该论文用数学证明填补了 Shu 等人提出的多值处理和结果情形下因果概率闭式界在高维是否紧致的空白，并证明 PNS、PSub、PRep 和 PN 均为单一统一公式的特例，从而在任意维度下以闭式形式完全解决了基于实验和观测数据的离散因果概率紧致界问题。
en_tdlr: This paper closes the open gap on the sharpness of Shu et al.'s closed-form bounds for probabilities of causation with multi-valued treatments and outcomes, and shows that PNS, PSub, PRep, and PN are all special cases of a single unified formula, thereby settling the sharp-bounds problem for discrete PoCs from experimental and observational data in closed form for every dimension.
